answer: The timber counter is kept in quill and lagoon exposes each reset. A hostile operator hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1745 identities would post 4061 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
